title: Author Insights (Quebec House, London) — Eric opens the UK tour with an intimate book conversation
summary: Eric kicks off his UK book tour with an Author Insights event at Quebec House in London on Sunday September 7 — the first stop before the Bookomi breakfast (Sep 8), Mishcon de Reya (Sep 8), Startup Leap × Huckletree (Sep 9), Octopus Energy (Sep 9), KPMG (Sep 10), and Disruptive Innovators Network (Sep 11).
blockquote: Author Insights at Quebec House, London — Sunday September 7, 2026. Direct confirmation from Eric; formal public listing to follow.
